# agentic-identity

People, agents, and the access they share: sign-in, delegation, invites, links, and an audit trail.

Status: 0.1.0 preview. Principals and delegation, sharing (roles, invites, links, audit), six ports (Store, Blobs, Auth, Realtime, Mail, Queue), memory and Cloudflare D1/R2 adapters, contract suites at agentic-identity/testing. No OIDC, SDK, CLI, MCP server, or HTTP API yet.

## Docs

- README: https://github.com/pooriaarab/agentic-identity
